hook_text: Change from R50 on a R41,49 bill — the way every cashier does it.
clip_script: A mental method, counting on, is how cashiers give change: from R41,49 add one cent to make R41,50, fifty cents to make R42, and eight rand to make R50. One cent plus fifty cents plus eight rand is R8,51. Check by adding: R41,49 plus R8,51 is R50,00.
visual_style: A till slip for R41,49; coins hop along a number line to R41,50, R42 and R50; the hopped coins collect into R8,51.
pacing: Three hops, then the total, then the check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to add and subtract decimals with three decimal places.
